finding.source_observation: Current main still stores backfill_files byte_offset without a cumulative absolute line checkpoint and resets local_line inside each incremental ingest_artifact_history invocation, while source_event_identity hashes line_no.
finding.consequence: The same physical workers.jsonl execution can receive different source_event_id values under one-shot versus resumed scanning. Therefore COUNT(DISTINCT source_event_id) is not yet a safe idempotence target for source_count until replay-stable source-event identity is fused and verified.
finding.counterhypothesis: PR1881 source_count reconciliation alone is sufficient because duplicate provenance links are distinct only when the underlying execution is genuinely distinct.
finding.falsifier: Scan one identical fixture once in one pass and once via multiple incremental resumes, then reconcile candidate provenance. Candidate source_event_id sets and source_count must be identical; an immediate second pass must change zero candidate/evidence counts.
